reviews.title: List option unhelpful
reviews.text: I thought this would be helpful to compare prices to the different grocery store sales. It is not. My first try was celery, and the items that came up weren’t even vegetables. Then I tried 2% milk, and again no fresh milk even came up. I then tried Polar seltzer water which I knew was in at least 2 weekly fliers of stores in my list and the result was only for 1 store (the higher priced one). I can see the weekly sales without the “help” of this app. I deleted the app.

reviews.title: Greed trumps common sense
reviews.text: Ok, I’m writing this first issue off to user error. I added butter to my list and got notified about the deals on it. Stocked up on butter. Removed from list. Kept getting notified about butter. I changed settings to delete list history daily. But I am still deleting the app permanently. I also have the same complaint that is the main complaint about the app in reviews. I get notifications for stores that are not in my favorites and that I would have to drive for hours to even get to. It would be simple for the developers to add a setting to notify only for stores in my favorites so why do they steadfastly refuse? Because their partners (stores) pay them for each time their ad is viewed and users don’t know to do that if they aren’t notified. I don’t use apps that abuse me so goodbye Flopp. I will not miss you.
